pr_title: Add support for metrics aggregations to mvt end point
pr_body:
After adding in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/78594 a new abstraction for aggregation builders, we can exploit it in the vector tile implementation to add support for any of the aggregations that uses the abstraction. In particular this PR adds support for the following aggregations:

* `boxplot`
* `extended stats`
* `median absolute deviation`
* `percentile`
* `percentile-rank`
* `stats`
* `value count`

closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/77072

issue_context.title: Support percentiles as an agg for _mvt format
issue_context.body:
Support the percentile aggregation for `_mvt`-requests. This aggregation is supported in Kibana Maps.
